title: Zenzic Baseline Schema
description: Schema for .zenzic-baseline.json snapshot files used for baseline and regression tracking.

score.description: Document Quality Score (DQS) at baseline creation.

findings_count.description: Total number of findings recorded in baseline.

signatures.description: Deterministic finding signatures (RuleCode + FileURI + Target/Context hash).

metadata.description: Additional metadata (e.g. zenzic version, git commit).
